status: Method development on the previously inspected 300 SciFact dev claims; confirmation on source-separated, unscored SciFact train claims.
weights: Each fitting query has equal total weight; inverse class frequency is computed only from fitting rows.
selection: Four inner folds, grouped by cited/evidence source families. Precision at exactly one admitted item per query on average. Exact ties prefer raw scores, then fewer features, then stronger regularization in declared candidate order.
comparisons: Choose separately among raw/logistic/histogram score-only candidates and all candidates including context. This isolates the added contextual information from classifier flexibility.
pooled_development: Hold out source families whose SHA256(20261015:calibration:family) mod 5 equals zero for threshold calibration. Use other source families for grouped model selection and final fitting. No performance on confirmation data is inspected during development.
confirmation: 537 train claims retained after source and text separation, 328 source families. Both original controlled pools and natural lexical top-100 pools; all methods share each pool and review budget. Freeze chosen models, source hashes and protocol before accessing confirmation performance.
primary_confirmation: Evidence precision at exactly 100 items per 100 queries, controlled pools; compare all-candidate selected system with both raw rationale and separately selected score-only control. Report natural pools, prospective workload, coverage and evidence recall as sensitivity analyses.
uncertainty: Paired source-family bootstrap with 2000 replicates; preserve all related claims. Fixed-batch intervals condition on the frozen selected batch. Report uncertainty and all declared comparisons.
smoke: Run seed 13 fitting and first 12 evaluation IDs; verify score independence from evaluation labels, verdict, row order; check exact budget. Full development requires unchanged protocol/source and passing smoke.
stopping: One full development run, freeze best selected system and score-only control, then one confirmation evaluation. No confirmation-driven candidate or threshold tuning.
